response.sql:
WITH project_counts AS (
  SELECT arcref, COUNT(*) AS qc_count
  FROM scanqc
  GROUP BY arcref
),
shares AS (
  SELECT arcref, qc_count,
         1.0 * qc_count / SUM(qc_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM project_counts
),
scored AS (
  SELECT arcref, qc_count, share,
         share - AVG(share) OVER () AS deviation
  FROM shares
)
SELECT arcref, qc_count, share, deviation
FROM scored
ORDER BY deviation DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Projects means distinct arcref values present in scanqc; the average share is across those projects, including only projects with at least one QC record.
